Subject: Need help with a geographical-indication dispute case

Hello, my name is Anjali Rajan. I am a 41-year-old chartered accountant living in Nagpur. Our producers' association has a geographical-indication dispute with Sunrise Foods Pvt Ltd over sales of INR 6,94,00,000/-, and the rival product uses the protected regional name on its label. My case number is CS(COMM) 1565/2019 in the Bombay High Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 09885258775 or email anjali.rajan@example.com.
